description: A physical model of a shaker or wind chime, built from particles that collide and ring: maracas, sleigh bells, bamboo and metal chimes

params.text: Shakes the particles once; holding it down shakes them continuously
Sets the number of particles, 1 to 150; more particles decay the system energy faster and fewer decay it slower
Sets the centre frequency of the particles, 100Hz to 10000Hz
Sets how far the particle frequencies spread either side of the centre frequency, 0 to 0.95 of it
Sets how far a particle's frequency is thrown at random on each collision

inputs.text: A gate shakes the particles for as long as it is high
Sets the centre frequency of the particles from a pitch voltage, 0V giving C4 at 261.63Hz, in place of the C knob
Sets the frequency spread from 0V to 10V, squared so that a small spread takes most of the range, in place of the SPREAD knob
Sets the energy of each shake, one tenth of the voltage here; the energy is 1 with no cable
Sets the number of particles from 0V to 10V, squared, over the range 1 to 150, in place of the PARTICLES knob

outputs.text: Carries the sounding amplitude of the whole system, ten times its running level
Fires a 1ms pulse of 10V on each particle collision
Carries the pitch of each collision, one polyphonic channel per voice

notes: nothing sounds until the particles are shaken, by the button or by a gate at the shake input.
menu: Polyphony channels — sets how many voices the collisions are spread across, Monophonic or 1 to 16
